finding_in_prior_unexecuted_source.description: The prior fixed original() used common.read with O_NOFOLLOW only on the leaf; the top checks did not cover callers/component-fixture and installed-control. The four installed originals could therefore resolve through an unchecked intermediate symlink. No runtime reproduction or product failure was claimed.

checked: All fixed35 original paths now use read_fixed_original, opened through held directory descriptors starting at /.

Every traversed directory uses O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC. Before and after reading, each parent/name relationship is compared against the held child descriptor identity (device/inode/mode/uid/gid).
The leaf uses O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC; it must be an owned regular file with nlink1. Its name binding, descriptor identity, size/mtime/ctime are checked before and after the exact-size read.
The read reserves remaining raw budget before reading and never reads an extra EOF byte beyond the admitted original size; oversized inputs are explicitly omitted without admitted content.
All acquired descriptors close in reverse order in finally. Per-file exceptions remain explicit READ_REFUSED/MISSING observations; the reader does not turn errors into product PASS.
Original fixed35 population, 8MiB raw and12MiB stdout limits, per-phase exact request/context and closed ECHILD gates, and the entire final framing section remain byte-identical.
Imported identity/blob/closed_owner were read from actual b272 common source and their full function texts match the previously reviewed exact e03f versions.
limitations: No Python parse, syscall controls, filesystem race tests, source generation, native compilation, product tests, h calls or workflow trigger were executed by this review.
This conclusion covers the new diagnostic original-file read path. It does not approve an unreviewed create/write/execution parent-chain adapter or the complete116 development workflow.
Before/after descriptor identity checks do not claim immunity to privileged namespace manipulation, hard SIGKILL, host loss, or changes invisible between snapshots.
The predecessor remains an unexecuted draft with this static gap; no actual historical result was rewritten.
